location.source_text: Place of occurrence: 901 Brock Rapids, New Johnhaven

description.value:
Vehicle FCV-6316 was struck on the front nearside by a second vehicle emerging from a side road onto
Brock Rapids. Minor damage to both vehicles, no injuries. Road was dry.
